subject: [PATCH 4/6] NFSD: Keep per-export statistics across export cache updates

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where NFS statistics are lost when an export cache entry is replaced or removed. To solve this, it introduces a per-net table to store statistics keyed on the export root and client name. Each export cache entry takes a reference to the shared statistics in svc_export_init() and drops it when freed. Statistics that have not been used for an hour are automatically freed by a delayed work item. This approach ensures that statistics are preserved across export cache updates, allowing tools to accurately track traffic over intervals.
